test_cases.title: View reports card on Home opens the Reports page
acs: DERIVED: The View reports card on /Home.aspx opens /Tabulations.aspx with h1 Reports and title Tabulations - Proficiency Testing - route /Home.aspx to /Tabulations.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
The card opens the page by postback.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Look for the View reports card under the Results section.
steps.expected: The View reports card is visible.

steps.action: Click the View reports card.
steps.expected: The browser navigates to the address path /Tabulations.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Reports.

steps.action: Read the browser tab title.
steps.expected: The title reads Tabulations - Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.

test_cases.title: Reports page shows the search form and the empty-state message
acs: DERIVED: /Tabulations.aspx shows the search labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Code and Scheme Name, the buttons SEARCH and SHOW ALL, and with no data the message There are no distributions to display - route /Tabulations.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
Local data has no distributions for reports. If the data set differs, the message step does not apply.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Tabulations.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 Reports and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the labels of the search form.
steps.expected: The labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Code and Scheme Name are shown.

steps.action: Look for the search buttons.
steps.expected: The SEARCH button and the SHOW ALL button are visible.

steps.action: Read the message below the search form.
steps.expected: The message reads There are no distributions to display.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

test_cases.title: Searching reports with an unknown reference keeps the empty result and SHOW ALL restores the list
acs: DERIVED: A search on /Tabulations.aspx with a reference that does not exist keeps the message There are no distributions to display, and SHOW ALL restores the list - route /Tabulations.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
Local data has no distributions, so SHOW ALL returns the same empty message.
Search is read-only. No business data is created, saved or submitted.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Tabulations.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 Reports.

steps.action: Type ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF in the Distribution Reference box.
steps.expected: The box shows ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF.

steps.action: Click the SEARCH button.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Reports and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the message below the search form.
steps.expected: The message reads There are no distributions to display.

steps.action: Click the SHOW ALL button.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Reports and the search form is still shown.

steps.action: Read the Distribution Reference box and the message.
steps.expected: The Distribution Reference box is cleared or empty and the message reads There are no distributions to display.

test_cases.title: Reports page keeps its heading after a reload and Back returns to Home
acs: DERIVED: /Tabulations.aspx reloads without error and keeps the h1 Reports, and browser Back returns to /Home.aspx - route /Home.aspx to /Tabulations.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
The View reports card opens the page by postback, so browser Back may re-request the home page.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Click the View reports card.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Reports.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.expected: The page reloads and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 is still Reports.

steps.action: Select the browser Back button.
steps.expected: The browser returns to the address path /Home.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.
